reasoning_traces.think:
The reasoning engine operates under a dual-dataflow model: primary catalog (C) or byte-equivalent twin (T) must be accessible for trace generation. When both are present, execution proceeds through L1–L5 layers. If only C is missing, the fallback loader transparently substitutes T without altering audit outputs, preserving trace integrity but masking the substitution. Removal of both files triggers a FileNotFoundError, halting execution entirely. This reveals a hard dependency structure where system stability hinges on the presence of at least one valid data source. The failure mode manifests as either silent degradation (when T substitutes C) or complete stoppage (when neither is available). These behaviors define a binary state space for trace validity and inform GSE’s state transition logic and GSI’s probabilistic inference framework.
